_readme: The Writer takes the first topic below whose status is 'todo', rotating categories. Add a topic by copying a line: id (short, unique), category (nepal | international | india), keyword (what people type into Google), angle (what the article should cover). The agent sets status to 'published' or 'rejected' itself. When every topic is used, it researches and adds new ones on its own.
